source: Original in-repository campus model and procedural Three.js scenes. No external footage.
renderer: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU (0x00002560) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)
codec: H.264 / yuv420p, CRF 19, faststart, AAC stereo
encoder: libx264 (installed NVENC requires a newer driver; rasterization remains hardware GPU)
rebuild: npm run dev; npm run render:cinematics
audio: Original AAC soundtracks, public/audio/endings/provenance.json. Runtime uses the same separate stems through the SFX bus; video remains muted for inline autoplay.
